definition.def: If you participate in an activity, you take part in it.
examples: They expected him to participate in the ceremony. [VERB + in]
Over half the population of this country participate in sport. [VERB in noun]
...special contracts at lower rates for participating corporations. [VERB-ing]

definition.def: the act of taking part in an activity or event
examples: a show with lots of audience participation
A back injury prevented active participation in any sports for a while.
